body: The test `test_very_low_gh_causes_molt_deaths` (molt_mineral_budget.rs:282-286) asserts `final_count < 30` starting from 30 shrimp over 500 hours with Ca=1.5 mg/L, Mg=0.3 mg/L. A single death satisfies this assertion. Tighten to something like `final_count < 25` or assert a minimum number of MoltFailure events that led to deaths.
